data.body: Resume milestone (2026-09-09): epic leaf census is 44 closed / 117 total, with 60 open, 11 in_progress, and 2 blocked. Four-worker capacity is fully used (root plus three background agents) on file-disjoint work. Root confirmed Gerrit 2933 for grisly-guardable-avocet at LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, and zero unresolved comments; exact-revision submit succeeded and server-rebased final aed541ddbde6d9860c8857dff3d97f054855728f is reachable from origin/main. Both that leaf and already-merged diminished-cosmologic-dolphin remain open pending non-author exact-final-SHA TSV audits and completion verification. The first five ready open leaves all have stale code-basis certificates; only restoring-cynical-woodborer was selected for immediate re-review, but two admission attempts returned GATE_CONGESTED with no verdict because both host gate slots are occupied. It remains open and unclaimed; no force override or source edit occurred. Full make verify remains intentionally deferred to Gerrit CI for this comments/documentation-only epic per operator direction.
